```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

creator_summary <- read_csv(
  "data/analysis/creator_summary.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

top_creators <- creator_summary %>%
  slice_max(impressions_total, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```

## Top creators by impressions

```{r}
top_creators
```

```{r}
ggplot(top_creators, aes(x = reorder(creator_name, impressions_total),
                         y = impressions_total)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top creators by total impressions",
    x = "Creator",
    y = "Total impressions"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
